# TPC-Havoc Q17_v6

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT SUM(lineitem_data.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly FROM (SELECT l.l_extendedprice, l.l_quantity, l.l_partkey FROM lineitem AS l, part AS p, (SELECT l_partkey AS pk, 0.2 * AVG(l_quantity) AS threshold FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey) AS avg_data WHERE p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND p.p_container = 'MED BOX' AND avg_data.pk = l.l_partkey AND l.l_quantity < avg_data.threshold) AS lineitem_data
```
